objectives.en: Classify data as structured, semi-structured or unstructured
Describe data capture, storage, retrieval, deletion and recovery

title.en: Data, information and types of data

body.en: Data is raw facts and figures, such as numbers, text, images or sounds. When data is processed and given context, it becomes information that helps in making decisions. Structured data is organised in rows and columns, like a table of student records. Unstructured data has no fixed format, such as photos, videos, audio and social media posts. Semi-structured data has some organisation through tags or keys but not a strict table, such as an email with header fields or an HTML or XML document.

points.en: Unstructured: images, audio, video, free text

Semi-structured data has some organisation through tags or keys but not a strict table, such as an email with header fields or an HTML or XML document.
narration.kn: ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳು. ಅದನ್ನು ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ ಸಂದರ್ಭ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಲು-ಕಾಲಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿರುವ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ರಚಿತ (structured), ಫೋಟೋ-ವಿಡಿಯೋಗಳಂತಹವು ಅರಚಿತ (unstructured), ಟ್ಯಾಗ್‌ಗಳಿರುವ ಇಮೇಲ್, XML ಮುಂತಾದವು ಅರೆ-ರಚಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ.

body.en: Data capturing is gathering data from sources, for example a biometric attendance machine or an online form. Data storage keeps it on devices such as hard disks, SSDs and the cloud. Data retrieval fetches it when needed. When a file is deleted, usually only its address entry is removed and the space is marked free, so the data can often be recovered with special tools until it is overwritten. This is why devices should be wiped securely before they are sold.

points.en: Deleted data can often be recovered until it is overwritten
Wipe storage securely before disposing of a device

narration.kn: ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ (capturing), ಶೇಖರಣೆ (storage), ಮರುಪಡೆಯುವಿಕೆ (retrieval) ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಹಂತಗಳು. ಫೈಲ್ ಅಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಅದರ ವಿಳಾಸ ಮಾತ್ರ ತೆಗೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಹೀಗಾಗಿ ಹೊಸ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಬರೆಯುವವರೆಗೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಮರುಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

problem.en: Classify each as structured, semi-structured or unstructured: (a) a spreadsheet of fee payments (b) a WhatsApp voice note (c) an email (d) a CCTV recording.

steps.en: A spreadsheet has fixed rows and columns, so (a) is structured.
An email has tagged header fields (To, From, Subject) plus a free-text body, so (c) is semi-structured.
A voice note and a CCTV recording have no fixed format, so (b) and (d) are unstructured.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Classify each as structured, semi-structured or unstructured: (a) a spreadsheet of fee payments (b) a WhatsApp voice note (c) an email (d) a CCTV recording.

narration.en: Recap. Data is raw facts; information is processed, meaningful data. Data can be structured, semi-structured or unstructured. Data is captured, stored and retrieved. Deleted data can often be recovered, so wipe devices securely.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಸಂಗತಿ; ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ. ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ರಚಿತ, ಅರೆ-ರಚಿತ ಅಥವಾ ಅರಚಿತವಾಗಿರಬಹುದು. ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಶೇಖರಿಸಿ, ಮರುಪಡೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಳಿಸಿದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಮರುಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು; ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಅಳಿಸಿ.
